syntaxCheck.scope: Actual JUCE 8.0.4 headers and actual engine headers. No plugin linking or native macOS build.

nativeCpuReport: Workflow measures DSP on its macOS runner before plugin build; always attempts upload of docs/cpu-macos-benchmark.json as Sculpt-Live-Clean-verifiche. Native benchmark not executed here.
stateHandoff: LearnedState fields are atomics; sequence fence snapshots carry matching Clear/Learn/restore acknowledgements. Audio takes one bounded attempt, no mutex. State XML callbacks only serialize with their own mutex and bounded snapshot retries. UI commands survive stopped-host save/reprepare, save overlays pending user intent. Learned noise profile and target notch frequencies persist. Preset restore supersedes pending Clear/Learn commands that preceded it; later UI requests remain pending. Two published slots retain a completed snapshot during audio publication/preemption; acquire/release completed-slot index selects it.
